description: Compute the trade balance for a country over one or more periods — total exports minus total imports — with optional commodity filter. Fetches export and import totals in parallel and returns the signed balance (USD), export value, import value, and coverage ratio (exports / imports). Note: mirror asymmetry is common — balance reflects values as reported by this country; the same flow may be recorded differently by the partner. Uses comtrade_lookup_countries to resolve reporter codes.

cmd_code.description: HS commodity codes to restrict the balance calculation. Omit to compute the overall trade balance across all commodities.

period.description: One or more annual periods (YYYY) or monthly periods (YYYYMM).

reporter_code.description: M49 numeric code of the reporting country.

name: comtrade_get_trade_balance

cmdCodes.description: Commodity codes used in the query (absent when querying all commodities).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `no_data`: No trade data available for the reporter and period combination. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

mirrorCaveat.description: Standard caveat about mirror asymmetry — balance reflects this country's reported values.

items.description: Trade balance values for a single reporting period.

balanceUsd.description: Trade balance in USD: exports minus imports. Positive = surplus.

coverageRatio.description: Export coverage ratio: exports / imports. >1 = surplus, <1 = deficit. Absent when imports is zero.

exportsUsd.description: Total exports value in USD for this period.

importsUsd.description: Total imports value in USD for this period.

note.description: Data note, e.g. when only one flow direction has data.

title: Get Trade Balance
